reason: ProposedEvent::CreateToken gains appended (TokenBatch list), the batches a replacement adds to one token-creation event (CR 614.1a + CR 616.1f), and PendingCounterPostAction gains ContinueTokenEventDelivery, the cursor that resumes such an event after one of its batches pauses.
